findings.scope: Original carrier plus supplied E8 charge dictionary; no physical field identification.
findings.statement: epsilon1 epsilon4 produces u1∧u4 in the carrier: Y=1/6 and source charge change0. Root operator, spinor carrier vector and affine root-current state have different types. The exterior unit is the internal nu^c label, not the affine vacuum.
findings.title: Concrete pair operator; source neutrality is not hypercharge neutrality

findings.scope: Only the supplied affine dictionary. Backgrounds or time-dependent covariant symmetries have different premises; no general gauge-physics no-go.
findings.statement: Mdelta=(-1/2,0,alpha/4,-1/2,0,(alpha-1)/4,-1/4,-1/4). The six (3,2) root energies are (0,1/2,1/2,1,1/2+alpha/4,1+alpha/4). K therefore does not commute with the fixed full SM action. The quarter phase is retained.
findings.title: Fixed quarter time splits the color/weak multiplet

findings.scope: Representation with metric/orientation; J_C is not yet the actual boundary/OS conjugation. Two carrier labels are not two vacua.
findings.statement: J_C=∏(epsilon_i+iota_i)K is antiunitary, exchanges S± and reverses Y. Exactly Lambda0 and Lambda5 have Y=0. J_C dGamma(h) J_C^-1=tr(h)I−dGamma(h). It is fully Spin(10)-equivariant. Reuse CAR.PAIR.01's bilinear pairing; CAR.PAIR.02's Hermitian selection inference has been corrected and is not evidence.
findings.title: Explicit conjugation for the existing sheet pairing

findings.scope: Given chiral source. No selection from P1/P2, no equal responses within one fixed twist, and no identification with affine r0.
findings.statement: n→−n−1, alpha→1−alpha gives C D_alpha C^-1=−D_(1−alpha). Particles become holes and conversely; normal charge reverses and positive excitation energy is preserved. The unique sea state maps to the other sea state without adding a zero vector within one domain.
findings.title: Actual partner map between quarter domains

findings.scope: Correction of the finite selection inference; no identification of I with the actual Calderon operator and no P1 countermodel.
findings.statement: CAR.PAIR.01 counts complex-bilinear singlets. The Hermitian scalar <f,g> already exists on S+; CAR.PAIR.02's 'scalar iff sheet-odd' inference is false in this reading. The previous J_C includes reversion signs and is fully Spin(10)-equivariant.
findings.title: Bilinear sheet pairing is not Hermitian kernel selection

findings.scope: Exact map of the supplied source and conditional E8 lift; first marking, source realization and physical event law are not derived from P1/P2. Both quarter domains remain explicit; no switch to another branch to solve a fixed-sector question.
findings.statement: n→−n−1 forces j→7−j and O=−MRM^T with O(x)=(x4,−x5,−x6,x1,−x2,−x3,x8,x7). O d_alpha=d_(1−alpha); P5_beta=O P5_alpha O^-1 and k_beta=k_alpha∘O^-1 need no new marking choice. Sea state and positive time are transported; the E8 current lift assumes the existing extension.
findings.title: Actual quarter conjugation transports the supplied marking

findings.scope: Only fixed fold time and fixed 5+3 marking. Covariant marking transport is positively constructed; other sources or dynamical dictionaries are not excluded.
findings.statement: After actual quarter conjugation the D5 projections of the time axis have distinct squared norms 129/256 and 137/256. Hence no orthogonal T satisfies T d_beta=d_beta and T O(P5)T^-1=P5. This excludes every Weyl correction in this fixed comparison.
findings.title: No time-stabilizing orthogonal repair of the fixed marking

findings.scope: Representation types of the supplied free realization; no selection from P1/P2 and no new spinor-CAR replacement.
findings.statement: D5_1 has ten real vector fermions; S± each contain 16 complex Ramond/spin-field states. Using S+ as an ordinary CAR coefficient would give c=16 and Spin(10) level 4. The documented c=8 connection uses 10+6 real fermions and mixed spin fields of weight 5/8+3/8=1.
findings.title: Spinor16 is a state sector, not a 16-real one-particle field
